items.name: haze-tokens
items.title: Haze UI Tokens
items.description: haze-ui 设计令牌（OKLCH 色板、间距、排版、动效）的引入与主题化指南。Design-token onboarding guide: where tokens.css lives and how to load, theme and interop it.
items.author: wmzy <https://github.com/wmzy>
items.docs: haze-ui ships JS and CSS separately. Import the stylesheet once in your app entry: `import 'haze-ui/styles.css'` (full sheet) or `import 'haze-ui/css/tokens.css'` plus per-component CSS. Activate tokens with the `lightTheme`/`darkTheme` + `spacing` + `typography` classes from 'haze-ui'. Details: https://github.com/wmzy/haze-ui/tree/main/registry
